Rajeshwari Suve M has achieved All India Rank (AIR) 2 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE) 2025 , making her a top performer in the most competitive exam in India. The UPSC Result 2025 was announced on 6th March 2026, ranking Rajeshwari Suve M at number two in the merit list, making her the female topper of the year.

Rajeshwari Suve M, who hails from Vadipatti, a town in the Madurai district of Tamil Nadu, has achieved this feat after years of hard work, dedication, and commitment to her work. Before this achievement, Rajeshwari Suve M was already working as a Deputy Collector (Training) in the Tamil Nadu Government.

Rajeshwari’s family has had a significant influence on her academic journey and her desire to work in the field of public administration.

Rajeshwari’s father is a businessman, while her mother is an Associate Professor in a government institution. This environment has helped her to develop an interest in learning and service to the community at an early age.
